name: VAT Validation API
description:
Unified VAT/Tax ID validation API for **54+ countries** — 27 EU via VIES plus 27+ non-EU countries.

One API, consistent responses, complete company data.

---

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.44api.dev/webhook/validate-vat \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"vatNumber": "69838046", "countryCode": "SI"}'
```

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🌍 54+ Countries | 27 EU + 27+ Non-EU coverage |
| 🔗 Unified API | One endpoint for all countries |
| 🏢 Company Data | Name, address, registration status |
| 💾 Smart Caching | 7-day cache, handles VIES outages |
| 🔒 IP Whitelist | Enterprise security feature |
| ⚡ Zapier Ready | No-code automation |

---

## 🌍 Country Coverage (54+ Countries)

### EU Countries (27) - via VIES
`AT` `BE` `BG` `HR` `CY` `CZ` `DK` `EE` `FI` `FR` `DE`* `EL` `HU` `IE` `IT` `LV` `LT` `LU` `MT` `NL` `PL` `PT` `RO` `SK` `SI` `ES`* `SE`

### Non-EU Active (27+)
`GB` UK · `CH` Switzerland · `NO` Norway · `AU` Australia · `NZ` New Zealand · `AL` Albania · `XK` Kosovo · `TR` Turkey · `GE` Georgia · `MD` Moldova · `UA` Ukraine · `BY` Belarus · `BA` Bosnia · `IS` Iceland · `IL` Israel · `KZ` Kazakhstan · `MK` North Macedonia · `RS` Serbia · `RU` Russia + more

> *Germany (DE) and Spain (ES) return validation status only, without company details due to data protection laws.
